method: Individually opened final images with view_image during this task; observations logged in comms.md. This file binds those manual reviews to final hashes; not an automated visual test.

look-options.png.observation: Matching miniature corner buildings, water-facing terrace and harbour palette. Material texture and props are richer than runtime; roof/window details are not mesh specifications.

exterior-stages.png.observation: Five comparable views: closed, café, bistro, joined-house restaurant, string-lit seafood house. Window contents are illustrative, not an exact countable floorplan; silhouettes are comparable rather than registered CAD cameras.

exterior-night.png.observation: Joined neighbouring frontage, guests and queue present. Detail/noisy stonework should be simplified for actual harbour distance; the terrace railing is atmosphere rather than a walkability solution.

interior-1.png.observation: Two tables/two chairs each; separate fridge, soup kettle, stove, prep and coffee. Camera corrected to a front-down view. Faint grid is not an exact8x5 surveyed layout; horizontal pass explores the original brief, not the newer front-to-back runtime divider.

interior-4.png.observation: Five small indoor tables + booth + terrace table = seven table groups. Grill/fryer/oven/sink-rack/bar visible. Brief14x7 mood study clearly labelled; current plan14x5/low walls takes precedence for implementation. Rendered Mira corrected toward accepted identity; miniature faces remain approximations.

kit-sheet.png.observation: All23 requested placeables plus one ship-clothes scale figure. Labels give proposed1x1/2x1 sizes and wall slots, with table4 corrected2x1. Plinths/chairs are illustrative: not measured collision or aisle footprints. Wall-net display has freestanding support in the concept; runtime can mount the net directly.

service-moment.png.observation: Fishers stove/grill, deckhand plates, hardhat engineer at smoking fryer, navigator coffee, Mira/queue and fish/coffee orders visible. Kitchen worktops/hands visible; waist-high pass can hide legs. No chef/waiter outfits. Crowd spacing and all foot routes unverified.

ui-1-arrange.png.observation: One green1x1 ghost under two-chair table; big rotate/cancel/check; clean table4 glyph/label2x1. Room is a mood background, not latest5-deep camera fit.44px targets, finger offset, undo, pathfinding, invalid-state copy and pan require interactive validation; drawer does not prove exact84px implementation.

ui-2-service.png.observation: Four ship-clothes role portraits, repair cue and order bubbles. Reception is the in-world desk/event rather than a fifth phone rail slot; actual staff rail should allow Reception. Speed controls and some tabs are visibly smaller than44px; expand hit areas in implementation.

ui-3-mira-plan.png.observation: Accepted Mira portrait language, dishes/ranges, fish/kg catch list and two special actions. Numbers illustrative; catch yields must be calculated from simulation. Plan card should be composited on the outbound voyage, not treated as a new location.

ui-4-prep.png.observation: Coffee removed from catch prep;10 grilled +8 soup +12 fillets =30 portions; fridge30/30 and market2fish cleaned. Controls deliberately enlarged. Fish art depicts finished dishes as category icons; boat prepares raw forms only. Forecast numerical range/market coin value and unavailable-recipe reason still need real data and native layout.

ui-5-closing.png.observation: 420 dishes +96 drinks +48 tips =564. Unsupported generated reward-unlock text replaced with neutral harbour reputation copy. Names, values and reviews are examples, not economy or crew decisions.

ui-service-desktop.png.observation: Distinct cook/serve/fix/coffee/reception portraits, rounded title, no chef outfits. Tiny world Mira cap still varies from accepted navy compass cap; reuse accepted Mira asset in production. Crew/world positions and view fit are concept art only.

contact.png.observation: A-D only as brief requests; UI screens are separate full-size PNGs. Contact thumbnails are for selection; inspect full sheets for detail.
